program.name: Better Posture
program.subject: Mobility & posture
program.blurb: Circuits for standing taller: wall slides, prone Y-T-W and chin tucks, then stretches that open the chest.
program.about: Circuits for standing taller: wall slides, prone Y-T-W and chin tucks strengthen the muscles that hold you upright. Each circuit is followed by a guided flow that opens the chest and upper back. Two days alternate the drills and stretches. Levels II and III add reps. Best done often, three or four times a week.
